description: A low-frequency oscillator with four waveshapes and a switch between two speed ranges

params.text: Sets the rate on an exponential scale: 0.01Hz to 2Hz with the range switch at S, and 0.1Hz to 20Hz at F
Chooses the shape: sine, triangle, a saw falling from positive to negative, or square
Sets the speed range, S for 0.01Hz to 2Hz and F for 0.1Hz to 20Hz

inputs.text: Returns the waveform to the start of its cycle on each rising edge, reading high above 1V and low below 0V

notes: the lamp glows green while the output is positive and red while it is negative

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
